items.title: PvP: Bold Vanilla
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
The PvP pack you have been waiting for!!! Bold and vibrant textures with features that are designed for PvP. A pack created using your comments and feedback, apply it in your own world or any server.

Features:
- Short swords 
- Low fire 
- Transparent UI 
- Clear chat
- Critical hit particles
- Highlighted and animated ores 
- Small food items
- Custom low shield
items.changelog:
Updated to 1.19 and 1.20 textures
Removed the custom shield model to keep compatibility with banner overlays

items.title: Kawaii School
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Welcome to Kawaii School, the school where everyone looks fabulous and fashionable!
Jump right into these cute skins and roleplay together with your friends. Adorable skins and endless possibilities to release the real teen inside of you!

- 12 charming skins
- 1 FREE skin!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Techno Demons
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
Dark trendy style, glowing neon ghoul outfits, techno vibe, let your horns show!

- Stylish techno outfits 
- 10 neon colors
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Skyblock Space Wars
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Survive in an intergalactic battle in the skies! Explore the nether through a giant portal and gather materials to defeat the ender dragon! Can you survive this war among the stars?

- 2 space ships
- 1 giant portal
- By inPixel

items.title: Mob Billionaires
items.creator: House of How
items.description: These just keep mobs moving up in the world! From riches to more riches, from the royal to the self-made elite, these skins are always dressed in success. Strike gold and more with these 11 billionaire mob skins!

items.title: Space Squad
items.creator: House of How
items.description: The countdown to cool starts here! Launch into orbit with this fun, colorful space crew. 15 galactic nomads wearing modern suits with radioactive, rainbow hues. Jump in and buckle up, these skins will blast you out of this world!

items.title: Laser Animals
items.creator: House of How
items.description: These laser, neon animals hail from the depths of space. Celestial cats, lunar dogs, orbiting birds, galactic bees, and more! 16 glowing animal skins in all. Adjust your trajectory and explore unlimited worlds with this new wild pack!

items.title: Masked Teens!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
The Masked Teens have swaggered into Minecraft!
Live out your fantasy with cool outfits and expressive masks!

+ 12 Masked Teen skins!
+ 1 FREE skin!
+ Includes boy and girl teen skins!

items.title: Frazzled
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description: You look frenzied, you look frazzled. Peaked as any alp. Flushed and rushed and razzle-dazzled. Now I can see you're in a rut in disarray. I'm not one to butt in but in fact, I must say if you'd take it easy, trust awhile. Don't look blue, don't look back. You'll pull through in just a while. Cause you're on the right track.

items.title: Dragon Friends HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Need a fantasy related skin for your next roleplay where you live among dragons? You can dress up as a cute dragon, or be a human imposter in dragon fashion! There are various colors to choose from.

+ 18 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Galaxy Cuties HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Become a shooting star! Wear a piece from this collection of starry fashion featuring planets and moons. Blend into the galaxy and be a super cute teen with purple, blue, and silver colors. 

+ 14 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Goth Demons HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
A collection of gothic yet cute styled fashion for teens, complete with demon horns and spooky eyes! Be the most trendy and aesthetic terror to enter your next PVP game or roleplay session. Perfect for celebrating Halloween or even just missing the style! 

+ 16 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Cartoon Mobs 2 HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Our cartoon styled skins are back with animals in mind! Wear a passive mob with a flat yet cute appearance. Great for roleplay or general survival as you farm and tend to the very mobs you're portraying.

+ 10 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Maids & Butlers
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These maids and butlers run a very tight ship! Make sure to wipe your feet before you step inside!

- 12 unique skins to suit any millionaires mansion!
- With a wide variety of uniform designs, you can find the perfect fancy skin to suit you!

items.title: Textile Buddies
items.creator: Lebleb
items.description:
These buddies have been stitched together from all kinds of fabrics and textiles to make color combinations you've never seen before! 

In this pack:
- 20 HD skins

items.title: Vikings
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Rule the seas and conquer the world, role-play with friends as a Scandinavian clan ready to defeat all enemies. Gear up with axes, swords, and helmets to become Viking warriors. Lead the clan into battle as a legendary viking king or queen.

- Stunning survival spawn 
- Great for roleplay
- By RareLoot

items.title: Animal Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
These are not your ordinary teens! Become your favourite animal of choice and show your friends how stylish you are! 

- 8 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Ninja Mobs
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
They lurk in the shadows waiting to attack the unsuspecting! They are always looking for new members to join their ranks! Do you have what it takes to become a warrior of the night? Then show it with these cool mob skins!

- 8 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Spacey Anime
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The space program is waiting for new recruits! Do you have the courage to become an astronaut and explore deep space? Prove yourself with these anime inspired skins and take off to unprecedented heights of coolness!

- 8 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Dragon Island
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
You awake on a pile of rocks unsure where you are when all of a sudden, a loud and deep voice greets you. You hastily look around until you see it, a gigantic dragon looking directly at you, welcoming you to Dragon Island!

- Stunning survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: Tie Dye Teens
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Colors all around the world! Choose your favorite color and free your spirit from the busy life of the city. Make your clothes, dye them as you like, and shine like a star in your designs! Get ready. Teens can't wait to meet you! 

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 teen skins 
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Anime Trend
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Welcome into another new anime realm! Meet fancy teens that can't wait to show you the latest trends in the city. Shine like a star and be the first to try the latest fashion while setting new trends! Become a weeb and explore the wonders of this Minecraft world!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 anime-themed skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: High School Fashion
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Be ready for anything with this awesome skin pack. 
These high school teens have the best fashion in the city. 
One free skin!

items.title: Spring Anime
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Spring is right around the corner! Feel the new heat wave through the city streets or enjoy the sweet smells of blooming flowers out in nature. Teens hang out in the busy center of the city. Enjoy the Easter holiday with your friends, while gobbling down candies and searching for eggs!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 spring-themed skins 
+ By Team Visionary
